finding_comments_status_pair_check.name: finding_comments_status_pair_check
finding_comments_status_pair_check.value:
(
        ("finding"."finding_comments"."kind" = 'note' and "finding"."finding_comments"."from_status" is null and "finding"."finding_comments"."to_status" is null)
        or (
          "finding"."finding_comments"."kind" = 'status_change'
          and "finding"."finding_comments"."from_status" in ('draft','active','not_actionable','converted','archived')
          and "finding"."finding_comments"."to_status" in ('draft','active','not_actionable','converted','archived')
        )
      )

public_update_review_candidates_resoluti.name: public_update_review_candidates_resolution_check
public_update_review_candidates_resoluti.value: ("voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."status" = 'pending' AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_by_actor_id" IS NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."dismissal_reason" IS NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."actioned_public_update_id" IS NULL) OR ("voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."status" = 'dismissed' AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_by_actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."dismissal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."dismissal_reason")) > 0 AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."actioned_public_update_id" IS NULL) OR ("voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."status" = 'actioned' AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_by_actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."dismissal_reason" IS NULL AND "voc"."public_update_review_candidates"."actioned_public_update_id" IS NOT NULL)

rfst_disallowed_has_reason.name: rfst_disallowed_has_reason
rfst_disallowed_has_reason.value: "voc"."reporter_facing_status_transitions"."allowed" = true OR ("voc"."reporter_facing_status_transitions"."forbidden_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("voc"."reporter_facing_status_transitions"."forbidden_reason")) > 0)

survey_questions_branch_structure_check.name: survey_questions_branch_structure_check
survey_questions_branch_structure_check.value: ("survey"."survey_questions"."branch_depth" = 0 and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_parent_question_id" is null and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_parent_depth" is null and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_trigger_option_key" is null) or ("survey"."survey_questions"."branch_depth" = 1 and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_parent_question_id" is not null and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_parent_depth" = 0 and "survey"."survey_questions"."branch_trigger_option_key" is not null)

surveys_lifecycle_check.name: surveys_lifecycle_check
surveys_lifecycle_check.value: ("survey"."surveys"."status" = 'draft' and "survey"."surveys"."opened_at" is null and "survey"."surveys"."closed_at" is null) or ("survey"."surveys"."status" = 'open' and "survey"."surveys"."opened_at" is not null and "survey"."surveys"."closed_at" is null) or ("survey"."surveys"."status" = 'closed' and "survey"."surveys"."opened_at" is not null and "survey"."surveys"."closed_at" is not null)

task_comments_status_pair_check.name: task_comments_status_pair_check
task_comments_status_pair_check.value:
(
        ("task"."task_comments"."kind" = 'note' and "task"."task_comments"."from_status" is null and "task"."task_comments"."to_status" is null)
        or (
          "task"."task_comments"."kind" = 'status_change'
          and "task"."task_comments"."from_status" in ('backlog','todo','doing','review','done','released','reopened')
          and "task"."task_comments"."to_status" in ('backlog','todo','doing','review','done','released','reopened')
        )
      )

voc_attachments_active_idx.name: voc_attachments_active_idx
voc_attachments_active_idx.where: "voc"."voc_attachments"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "voc"."voc_attachments"."voc_id" IS NOT NULL

voc_attachments_subject_not_both.name: voc_attachments_subject_not_both
voc_attachments_subject_not_both.value: not ("voc"."voc_attachments"."voc_id" is not null and "voc"."voc_attachments"."comment_id" is not null)

voc_attachments_comment_kind_pair.name: voc_attachments_comment_kind_pair
voc_attachments_comment_kind_pair.value:
("voc"."voc_attachments"."comment_id" is null and "voc"."voc_attachments"."comment_kind" is null)
        or ("voc"."voc_attachments"."comment_id" is not null and "voc"."voc_attachments"."comment_kind" in ('public_update','reporter_reply','internal_comment'))

voc_public_updates_skip_invariants.name: voc_public_updates_skip_invariants
voc_public_updates_skip_invariants.value: ("voc"."voc_public_updates"."skip_public_update" = true AND "voc"."voc_public_updates"."body_rich_content" IS NULL AND "voc"."voc_public_updates"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("voc"."voc_public_updates"."skip_reason")) >= 8 AND "voc"."voc_public_updates"."reporter_facing_status_before" <> "voc"."voc_public_updates"."reporter_facing_status_after") OR ("voc"."voc_public_updates"."skip_public_update" = false AND "voc"."voc_public_updates"."body_rich_content" IS NOT NULL AND "voc"."voc_public_updates"."skip_reason" IS NULL)
